title: Rams receiver Nacua is in rehab, attorney says

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Rams receiver Nacua is in rehab, attorney says
sources.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua has checked in to rehab, his attorney told The California Post. Last month, a woman in Los Angeles filed a lawsuit against Nacua alleging he made an "unprovoked antisemitic statement" and later bit her on the shoulder.
